browserSignInTitle: Sign in to Nimi securely in your browser
browserSignInDescription: Your Nimi credentials are entered only in your browser. Once you're signed in, you'll be returned securely to this device.
browserSignInWaitEnded: Stopped waiting. If you already finished signing in in the browser, Nimi continues from your account state.
loginPending: Complete sign-in in your browser. This window will continue automatically.
reauthenticationRequired: Please sign in again to continue.
runtimeAccountUnavailableDescription: Your partners and conversations stay hidden until Nimi can confirm who is signed in. Unsent drafts are kept.
logoutRuntimeTransientFailure: Couldn't confirm that you were signed out. Your account session may still be active: {{error}}
logoutRuntimeFailure: Couldn't complete sign-out. Your account session may still be active: {{error}}
switchAccountRuntimeFailure: Couldn't switch accounts because the request wasn't confirmed: {{error}}
